sloka: सम्पन्नं राज्यमिच्छंस्तु व्यक्तं प्राप्याभिषेचनम् ।आवां हन्तुं समभ्येति कैकेय्या भरत: सुत: ॥ २.९६.१७॥
transliteration: sampannaṁ rājyamicchaṁstu vyaktaṁ prāpyābhiṣecanam ।āvāṁ hantuṁ samabhyeti kaikeyyā bharata: suta: ॥ 2.96.17॥

translations.english: It is evident that Kaikeyi's son Bharata, who has been consecrated, is coming to slay both of us desiring the prosperous kingdom (to be without obstacles).
translations.hindi: कैकेयी ने न्रन्जित हो, महषिं के चरण छुए और उन ऐश्बयवान.महूर्षि की परिक्रमा कर
